def.brief: Prepare the jokbo 2.0.0 CANDIDATE. This is release preparation only: no tag, push, release or install. The branch stays private, and a clean public history is prepared separately. Edits: (1) the five version values go from 1.8.1 to 2.0.0: plugin.json, .claude-plugin/plugin.json, .codex-plugin/plugin.json, and .claude-plugin/marketplace.json metadata.version and plugins[jokbo].version. .agents/plugins/marketplace.json keeps having no version field. engines.python stays '>=3.11' in all three manifests. (2) README Versioning: replace the 'Pending, unreleased ... no version is bumped for it now' paragraph with a timeless, release-ready statement that 2.0.0 is that major: it raised the Python floor of plugin.json and .claude-plugin/plugin.json from 3.9 to 3.11, dropping Python 3.9 and 3.10. The major rule above it stays. Not changed: jokbo.py, hooks/, test_jokbo.py, skills/, commands/, AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, and every historical example in the README; no algorithm and no shared hostcall. jokbo.version() reads plugin.json and is part of the cache key, so the candidate's disposable .jokbo/ cache rebuilds. The environment stays the released one: hunsu.json, hunsu.lock.json and hunsu-judgments.json still pin jokbo 1.8.1, and the installed 1.x engines manage this 2.0.0 source, which is not installed. No instruction text changes, so there is no rejudge; the three resolutions stay reviewed:false. Checks: the version and packaging fields (jokbo.version() read under Python 3.11); the timeless wording; the exact scope since 56444b4 (four manifests change only their version lines, README only inside Versioning, no .py); links and imports; the CLI and command adapters under 3.11; the unchanged core suite test_jokbo.py, 52 checks, on Python 3.11 with a child 'python3' on PATH that is also 3.11; git diff --check.
checks: import json, os, sys; sys.path.insert(0, '.'); import jokbo; L = lambda p: json.load(open(p)); m = {p: L(p) for p in ('plugin.json', '.claude-plugin/plugin.json', '.codex-plugin/plugin.json')}; mk = L('.claude-plugin/marketplace.json'); ag = L('.agents/plugins/marketplace.json'); v = {p: d['version'] for p, d in m.items()}; v['marketplace.json metadata.version'] = mk['metadata']['version']; v['marketplace.json plugins[jokbo].version'] = [p['version'] for p in mk['plugins'] if p['name'] == 'jokbo'][0]; py = {p: d.get('engines', {}).get('python') for p, d in m.items()}; agp = [p for p in ag['plugins'] if p['name'] == 'jokbo'][0]; cx = m['plugin.json']['extensions']['com.openai']['hooks']; hk = lambda f: sorted({h['command'].split('/hooks/')[1].strip(chr(34)) for g in L(f)['hooks'].values() for x in g for h in x['hooks']}); ok = set(v.values()) == {'2.0.0'} and jokbo.version() == '2.0.0' and set(py.values()) == {'>=3.11'} and agp['source']['path'] == './' and 'version' not in agp and 'version' not in ag and cx == './hooks/codex.json' and os.path.isfile(cx) and m['.codex-plugin/plugin.json']['skills'] == './skills/' and os.path.isfile('skills/read/SKILL.md') and hk('hooks/hooks.json') == hk('hooks/codex.json'); print('versions', v, '| jokbo.version() under', sys.version.split()[0], '=', jokbo.version(), '| engines.python', sorted(set(py.values())), '| .agents marketplace jokbo ./ without version:', agp['source']['path'] == './' and 'version' not in agp, '| codex hooks', cx, '| same handlers both hosts:', hk('hooks/hooks.json') == hk('hooks/codex.json')); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import sys; s = open('README.md').read(); sec = ' '.join(s[s.index('## Versioning'):s.index('### Release and adoption')].split()); stale = [w for w in ('Pending', 'unreleased', 'now declare', 'no version is bumped', 'next major') if w in sec]; need = [w for w in ('2.0.0', 'from 3.9 to 3.11', 'dropping Python 3.9 and 3.10', 'dropping a supported Python or host version') if w not in sec]; print('Versioning: stale pending wording left:', stale, '| timeless v2 statement missing:', need); sys.exit(1 if stale or need else 0)

import re, subprocess, sys; g = lambda *a: subprocess.run(['git', *a], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout; files = sorted(g('diff', '--name-only', '56444b4', '--', '.', ':(exclude).chongdae', ':(exclude)reviews').split()); meta = ['.claude-plugin/marketplace.json', '.claude-plugin/plugin.json', '.codex-plugin/plugin.json', 'plugin.json']; ch = lambda f: [l for l in g('diff', '-U0', '56444b4', '--', f).split(chr(10)) if l[:1] in ('+', '-') and not l.startswith(('+++', '---'))]; mv = {f: ch(f) for f in meta}; mok = all(len(ls) == (4 if 'marketplace' in f else 2) and all(re.fullmatch(r'[-+] *"version": "(1\.8\.1|2\.0\.0)",?', l) for l in ls) for f, ls in mv.items()); rh = [(int(a), int(b) if b else 1) for a, b in re.findall(r'^@@ -\S+ \+(\d+)(?:,(\d+))? @@', g('diff', '-U0', '56444b4', '--', 'README.md'), re.M)]; new = open('README.md').read().split(chr(10)); lo = new.index('## Versioning') + 1; hi = new.index('### Release and adoption') + 1; rok = bool(rh) and all(lo <= a and a + max(n, 1) - 1 < hi for a, n in rh); ok = files == sorted(meta + ['README.md']) and mok and rok; print('changed since 56444b4:', files, '| manifests change only version 1.8.1 -> 2.0.0:', mok, '| README hunks', rh, 'inside Versioning', lo, '-', hi - 1, ':', rok, '| any .py changed:', any(f.endswith('.py') for f in files)); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

import os, re, sys; fence = lambda s: re.sub(r'(?ms)^\`\`\`.*?^\`\`\`', '', s); slug = lambda h: re.sub(r'[^\w\- ]', '', h.strip().lower()).replace(' ', '-'); heads = lambda f: {slug(m) for m in re.findall(r'^#+ +(.+?) *$', fence(open(f).read()), re.M)}; links = [(f, l) for f in ('README.md', 'AGENTS.md') for l in re.findall(r'\]\(([^)\s]+)\)', fence(open(f).read())) if not l.startswith(('http://', 'https://', 'mailto:'))]; tgt = lambda f, l: os.path.join(os.path.dirname(f), l.partition('#')[0]) if l.partition('#')[0] else f; bad = [f + ' -> ' + l for f, l in links if not os.path.exists(tgt(f, l)) or (l.partition('#')[2] and l.partition('#')[2] not in heads(tgt(f, l)))]; imp = open('CLAUDE.md').read() == '@AGENTS.md\n'; print('relative links checked:', len(links), '| broken:', bad, '| CLAUDE.md is only the AGENTS.md import:', imp); sys.exit(0 if links and not bad and imp else 1)

import os, subprocess, sys, tempfile; d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); os.symlink(sys.executable, os.path.join(d, 'python3')); env = dict(os.environ, PATH=d + os.pathsep + os.environ.get('PATH', '')); v = subprocess.run(['python3', '-c', 'import sys; print(sys.version.split()[0])'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.strip(); r = subprocess.run([os.path.join(d, 'python3'), 'test_jokbo.py'], env=env, capture_output=True, text=True); out = r.stdout.splitlines(); p = sum(l.startswith('PASS ') for l in out); f = [l[:120] for l in out if l.startswith('FAIL ')]; ok = r.returncode == 0 and sys.version_info[:2] == (3, 11) and v.startswith('3.11.') and p == 52 and not f; print('parent python', sys.version.split()[0], '| child python3 on PATH', v, '| test_jokbo.py exit', r.returncode, '| PASS', p, '| FAIL', f, '|', out[-1] if out else ''); sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)
